capabilities.justification: The public collector defaults to monotonicClock, which calls process.hrtime.bigint.
The CLI reads GIT_REVISION when --revision is absent.
The CLI reads GITHUB_SHA as a fallback when --revision and GIT_REVISION are absent.
The CLI emits its JSON report through console.log and failures through console.error; the taxonomy unifies both streams under stdout.write.

justification: Unsigned proposal for the existing TypeScript library-plus-driver package. process.argv is command-line input, not an environment read. process.version/platform/arch are runtime metadata, not an enumerated capability operation; no package-source filesystem access was found.
